title: Had a wonderful time with @cleverdevil and @mblaney watching the Women's World Cup and then talking about how much we love #@withknown as an #IndieWeb
summary: Had a wonderful time with @cleverdevil and @mblaney watching the Women's World Cup and then talking about how much we love #@withknown as an #IndieWeb tool. After a day at @mozilla #pdx for Organizing meet-up. I guess it was meant to be a day of champions.
